title: The Midnight Oath Revisited
author: W. M. Reyes
blurb: August Montrose, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
